paper.title: SkillOS: Learning Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
paper.central_claim: SkillOS以相关任务组和复合奖励训练技能curator，使冻结executor在后续任务中通过不断编辑的SkillRepo提高效果和效率，并跨executor和领域泛化。

evidence.quote: Recent studies explored reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize skill-based agent systems.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者将已有RL技能使用和短流curation列为最近邻；仅属本文叙述，未独立阅读邻居原文。
curator接收轨迹、自判正确性、检索到的技能，而非未来任务；与本节insert/update/delete接口合读。

evidence.quote: The updated repository is then used by the executor on subsequent tasks, forming a closed loop between task execution and experience-driven skill evolution.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确写回和后续任务读取链条。

evidence.quote: To provide downstream learning signals for skill curation, we construct each training instance as a group of related tasks that are solved sequentially.
evidence.support_explanation: 相关任务组为延迟下游credit提供训练信号；不是每个技能的反事实价值。

evidence.quote: The first task uses an empty
evidence.support_explanation: 首任务不受curator影响，任务reward排除首任务。

evidence.quote: We report averaged performance and standard deviation over 3 runs.
evidence.support_explanation: 三运行均值与标准差；未报告显著性检验或训练种子层级区分。
Qwen3-8B executor下SkillOS宏平均SR 61.2±4.6，18.9步；同表ReasoningBank 55.7±3.1，20.1步。

evidence.quote: Without the content-quality reward, the success rate drops from 61.2 to 58.6
evidence.support_explanation: 内容奖励消融；同段去压缩60.0、去分组57.3。支持部分组件归因。

evidence.quote: The full training process takes approximately 3 days for ALFWorld, 2.5 days for reasoning tasks, and 5 days for WebShop.
evidence.support_explanation: 结合16 H100提供训练费用量级；不包含全部标注和在线curator开销。

evidence.quote: All baselines share the same frozen Agent Executor and are evaluated under identical task suites, retrieval budgets, and decoding settings to isolate the contribution of the memory mechanism.
evidence.support_explanation: 同executor/检索/解码控制，但训练总预算与零训练baselines不等价。

evidence.quote: but forgoes end-to-end optimization against task performance.
evidence.support_explanation: base为同架构同prompt同接口未训练curator的直接控制。

evidence.quote: Failed episodes contribute steps up to their termination point
evidence.support_explanation: 失败计入步数；SR、WebShop程序奖励、math_verify及GPQA exact-match有明确分母。

evidence.quote: Unless stated otherwise, all numbers in the main paper are computed on the official held-out evaluation splits of each benchmark.
evidence.support_explanation: 官方评测集与curator训练集分离，但在线测试流中库继续更新；没有另行冻结技能库的纯holdout评测或实测污染审计。

evidence.quote: The content quality reward evaluates whether the curated skills are semantically meaningful and likely to be useful for future tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 质量judge只是训练辅助，不能当独立执行验证门控；最终测量采用benchmark真值。

evidence.quote: We leave the joint optimization of skill curation and skill retrieval to future work.
evidence.support_explanation: BM25/curator解耦及检索局限被承认。

evidence.quote: This simplification keeps the curator’s action space tractable, but it discards two affordances of the original SKILL.md format:
evidence.support_explanation: 只存单文件文本技能，不声称已经验证可执行/层级技能。

evidence.quote: most off-diagonal entries still bring performance improvement over baselines
evidence.support_explanation: 作者跨领域迁移结论；限定为多数，而非全部场景。
